result:
Everything is done: `make verify` passed, screenshots are captured and asserted, the work is committed, both vite servers are stopped, and the tree is clean.

## 1. Changed

- `frontend/src/components/LoadError.tsx` (new) — shared "Failed to load: … · RETRY" block, same look as the Observability error block, `inline` variant for table cells.
- `frontend/src/components/DataTable.tsx` — new `error` / `onRetry` props render `LoadError` in place of the empty copy.
- `frontend/src/components/index.ts` — exports `LoadError`.
- `frontend/src/layout/useHealth.ts` — returns `{ health, status: "loading" | "ok" | "down", refresh }`, probes every 30 s and on window `online` / `focus`, 8 s timeout, keeps the last good payload through an outage.
- `frontend/src/layout/Shell.tsx` — passes `healthStatus` to the topbar.
- `frontend/src/layout/Topbar.tsx` — chip bound to the probe: green LED + `topbar.allSystemsGo` only for `ok`, otherwise `crit` LED + `topbar.backendDown`, same chip box, `data-testid="topbar-health"` / `data-status`.
- `frontend/src/lib/api.ts` — `getJson`, `responseMessage`, `errorMessage` helpers so by-path fetches follow the `apiErrors.*` localisation rules.
- `frontend/src/pages/Overview.tsx` — agents and overview hooks track `error` + `retry`; tiles show "failed to load", launch feed and service-health panel render `LoadError`.
- `frontend/src/pages/Registry.tsx` — load via `getJson`; `registry.unavailable` 503 keeps its own page, everything else renders `LoadError` in the table.
- `frontend/src/pages/KnowledgeBases.tsx` — same pattern; never coerces a failure to `[]`.
- `frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx` — agent list failure shows `LoadError` in the thread and "failed to load" in the picker instead of "no active agents".
- `frontend/src/pages/Evaluation.tsx` — runs table renders `LoadError` when the runs fetch fails.
- `frontend/src/pages/EvaluationExperiment.tsx` — experiments table renders `LoadError` when the list fetch fails.
- `frontend/src/theme/app.css` — `.load-error` (aliased with `.obs-error`), `.syschip.down`, `.syschip .led.crit`.
- `frontend/src/locales/{en,zh-CN}/common.json` — `common.retry`, `common.loadFailed`, `common.loadFailedShort`, `topbar.backendDown`, `apiErrors.network`.
- `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/architecture.zh-CN.md` — new "Console failure states (backend unreachable)" section.

## 2. Verified

- `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint` — pass (one pre-existing `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` warning at EvaluationExperiment.tsx:668, untouched by this change).
- `python3 scripts/i18n_check.py` — PASS, 2844 keys, parity OK.
- `make verify` (foreground) — PASS. Tail:

```

```

- Playwright evidence script `se002_shots.mjs` (saved next to the screenshots) against :5198 (dead API) and :5197 (live :8000): every dead page had chip `data-status="down"` reading "BACKEND UNREACHABLE", at least one `.load-error` with a Retry button, and none of "none yet / NO RECORDS / No knowledge bases yet / no active agents / NO EXPERIMENTS / NO RUNS YET / NO DEPLOYMENTS YET" in the main DOM text. Live overview had chip `ok` "ALL SYSTEMS GO" and zero error blocks.
- Retry: clicking the Registry Retry button issued exactly one new request to `/api/registry/records`.
- Recovery (`se002_recover.mjs`): with the page open on the dead console, a stub server was started on :8999 and a `focus` event dispatched; the chip went from "BACKEND UNREACHABLE" to "ALL SYSTEMS GO" without a reload, and Retry on the launch feed then rendered the real "NO DEPLOYMENTS YET" empty copy (`recovered_overview.png`).

## 3. Acceptance checks

- ✅ Shared component `frontend/src/components/LoadError.tsx`, exported from `components/index.ts`, used by Overview, Registry, Knowledge Bases, Chat, Evaluation runs, Experiments (also through `DataTable` `error`/`onRetry`).
- ✅ `useHealth` returns `{ health, status, refresh }`, re-probes every 30 s and on `online`/`focus`; Topbar shows `topbar.allSystemsGo` + green LED only for `status === "ok"`, otherwise `crit` LED + `topbar.backendDown` (en + zh-CN).
- ✅ Dead-backend screenshots `dead_overview/registry/knowledge_bases/chat/evaluation/experiments.png` saved under `.claude/self-evolution/runs/SE-002/` in this worktree and copied to `/home/ubuntu/workspace/agentcore_launchpad/.claude/self-evolution/runs/SE-002/`; DOM assertions above confirm red chip, error+Retry, no empty copy.
- ✅ `live_overview.png` shows the green chip and the normal Overview with live data.
- ✅ Retry re-issues the fetch (request count) and the chip recovers without reload (`recovered_overview.png`).
- ✅ `python3 scripts/i18n_check.py` and `make verify` pass; no live AWS needed.
- ✅ `make verify` passes in this worktree.
- ⚠️ Hermetic test: the repo has no frontend unit-test runner and this change is frontend-only, so no `backend/tests/` test applies. The gate covers it through tsc, eslint, vite build and i18n parity; the Playwright scripts are saved with the screenshots but are not run by the gate.
- ✅ `docs/architecture.md` and `docs/architecture.zh-CN.md` updated; no new routes, so `docs/api.md` unchanged.

## 4. Not done / deviations

- **Screenshot location.** The brief's relative path resolved to the worktree; the host looked in the main checkout. Both directories now hold the same PNGs and scripts. Nothing under `.claude/` is committed.
- **No gate-run frontend test.** See the check above. Adding a test runner to the gate would have widened scope.
- **Overview beyond the two named surfaces.** The active-sessions, registry-assets and eval-pass-rate tiles and the service-health rows also derive from `/api/overview`, and on a dead backend they rendered "none yet" / "NONE YET". I made them show "failed to load" and the health panel render `LoadError`, because otherwise the dead overview screenshot could not satisfy the no-empty-copy check.
- **Registry network error semantics changed.** A true network failure used to route to the "REGISTRY UNAVAILABLE" page, which claims the account has no Registry. It now renders the load error with Retry; only a 503 `registry.unavailable` keeps the dedicated page.
- **Loading state reads as down.** Per the acceptance wording, the chip is red until the first probe answers. Locally that is a sub-100 ms flash.
- The previous session's `recovered_overview.png` stub server on :8999 was stopped; the two vite servers are stopped; nothing else is left running.
